summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Alterity Therapeutics Ltd, a foreign private issuer, for July 2026. The filing incorporates by reference into several existing registration statements (S-8 and F-3) and includes an exhibit for an application for quotation of securities (ATH 1). No special situation such as acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change is disclosed. The filing is a routine current report regarding securities quotation. No deal terms are provided.
